source_policy: release 2026.11.19b-telegram-notify: optional Telegram messages, sent only when both TRANSLATOR_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TRANSLATOR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID are set; key-state alerts in dual-key mode (primary unusable and switched to backup, restored to primary, both keys unusable; TRANSLATOR_TELEGRAM_KEY_ALERTS, default on), one per state change, throttled per kind by TRANSLATOR_TELEGRAM_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS (default 1800) with a held-back state offered again by the next request once the interval allows; one message per finished translation task (TRANSLATOR_TELEGRAM_NOTIFY_DONE, default off) giving success figures or a failure class and the recorded error, at most 300 characters; TRANSLATOR_TELEGRAM_LABEL and TRANSLATOR_TELEGRAM_DISABLE; plain text, background send, 10 s timeout, no retry, a failed send logs one warning and never touches the task, no token in logs; the installer asks an optional Telegram question and a reinstall keeps LLM_*, OPENAI_*, CLAUDE_*, ANTHROPIC_*, TRANSLATOR_LLM_PROVIDER and TRANSLATOR_TELEGRAM_* lines; without the Telegram variables behaviour is unchanged; no new runtime dependency; prompts and caches unchanged
excluded_classes: production uploads, outputs, progress, tasks, caches, logs and installer state
fonts, audit evidence, backups and Git metadata
tests, test requirements and release tooling (kept in the source repository)
validation: Local regression suite: 2275 passed, 2 skipped (Python 3.13, constraints.txt, PyMuPDF 1.27.2.3), including tests of every translation-stage path with the sign check, the sign proximity check at assembly, stacked table cells, invisible source text, the numeric row spellings, placeholder leaks across whitespace and the page record cleanup, each new condition checked by mutation; on the production host, offline and keyless, six real production jobs run through the real translation stage (with the page that failed the previous release, a retry forced by an untranslated element and a failing retry) and through reassembly: every task completes, no page newly restored to its source against the live release, no internal placeholder token in any text layer, no element recorded twice; six review rounds by two independent reviewers.
